source: Blender Studio Human Base Meshes (via public/anatomy/fitness-reference.glb)
look: the fitness reference body (same sculpt, head and face) without clothing; smooth one-piece shop-mannequin pelvis without sex features
modifications: Shorts mesh and unused UVs removed; UV-seam duplicates welded (identical normals, lossless).
Groin/perineum: biharmonic fairing of 331 vertices, Taubin relaxation of the patch + 3-ring rim, Laplacian rounding of the crotch apex -> smooth continuous mannequin surface.
Normals recomputed on the faired patch only and feathered into the original normals over 4 edge rings; every other vertex and normal is unchanged.
limits: Muscle panels are drawn per pixel by src/muscle-map.js: location only, never EMG or effort.
